data.name: Marble Tilt
data.detailed_description:
Marble Tilt is a relaxing physics-based puzzle game where you guide a marble through handcrafted wooden mazes simply by tilting the board.

Each stage is a small mechanical challenge that rewards precision, timing, and flow.

Built with PC and Mac in mind.

Features

  • 25 handcrafted tilt-maze puzzles designed for relaxing but skillful play

  • Smooth and natural physics with responsive control

  • A calming wooden atmosphere with matching audio

  • Tested on a game controller and keyboard. More precise on analog controller stick.

  • Easy at first — then more challenging. Master the tilt, find the fastest routes, and climb the leaderboard.

Perfect for players who enjoy relaxing physics puzzles, marble mazes, and precision-based wooden labyrinth challenges.

Bluetooth controllers are supported as well, but since it is not possible to test every hardware combination, this option is not officially marked. It has been verified to work wirelessly with a PS5 controller on a MacBook Air M4.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 5000 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 660 / AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
